observed_high-performers_common_patterns: Dedicated emergency page; phrases like “same-day” or “call now” near fold; phone anchored in header.
Clear insurance/financing explainer (many highlight Medicaid or major PPOs).
Strong service detail pages for implants/aligners with FAQs and outcome language.
Prominent review count/ratings and easy path to schedule or call.
Google Business Profile (GBP) linked; consistent NAP across site/footer.
Multiple local category touchpoints (Dentist, Emergency Dental Service, Cosmetic Dentist, Dental Implants).

seo_research_and_plan.why_these: They align with competitor SERP presence and typical local dental demand; competitors actively build pages around these terms (see sources in competitor_snapshot_examples).

core_actions: Ensure categories include: Dentist (primary), Emergency dental service, Cosmetic dentist; add others as appropriate.
Add appointment URL (Dentrix), services list, hours, languages, insurance note (Medicaid/ForwardHealth), attributes (wheelchair access, etc.).
Upload high-quality photos (exterior, interior, team, treatment rooms); post updates for offers and emergencies.
Collect & respond to reviews; encourage keywords like 'emergency', 'implants', 'aligners', 'Medicaid'.

on_site_essentials: Crystal-clear NAP in footer and contact; click-to-call.
Unique meta titles/descriptions with local modifiers (Green Bay, neighborhood cues).
Structured data: Dentist (LocalBusiness) on home; BreadcrumbList on inner pages; Review/Rating where applicable.
Fast load; responsive images; internal linking between related services; location cues near Lambeau/Oneida St.
Accessibility and multilingual content (English/Spanish/Arabic) to match service area.
